title: Your Savings Account May Earn Just 0.38%
description: The FDIC national average savings rate was 0.38% in October 2026. On $10,000, that's about $38 a year, versus $400 at a hypothetical 4% APY; rates vary by bank. Educational only, not financial advice. #savingsaccount #personalfinance #shorts

title: His Game Failed. Its Chat Tool Became Slack
description: Stewart Butterfield shut down his online game Glitch in 2012. The team's internal chat tool became Slack, which Salesforce agreed to buy for about $27.7 billion in 2020 (deal closed July 2021). #slack #entrepreneur #shorts
